title: Fireball® Horchata Pops
description: These boozy rice milk ice pops are spiked with cinnamon whiskey and cayenne for a grownup version of a summertime treat.
ingredients: 0.75 cup white sugar, or to taste

steps.text: Grind rice finely using a coffee or spice grinder. Transfer to a large bowl; add cinnamon sticks. Pour in warm water. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit, 8 hours to overnight.

Strain rice mixture through a sieve set over a bowl. Press against the rice with a wooden spoon to squeeze out as much liquid as possible; discard rice. Stir rice milk and sugar into strained liquid to make horchata.
Measure 2 1/2 cups horchata into another bowl. Add cinnamon whiskey, cayenne pepper, and 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon. Pour into ice pop molds.
Freeze until solid, at least 12 hours.
Run molds under warm water to release ice pops. Sprinkle with an additional dash of cinnamon before serving.

video.description: Spiking the classic Latin American rice beverage horchata with hot cinnamon whiskey and cayenne before freezing into ice pops really makes the flavor pop! Sweet, spicy and cool, the refreshing combination of ice cold with spicy heat makes this a winning summertime flavor.
